other_failure_modes.name: Hardcoded Submission ID
other_failure_modes.description: The agent generates the submission ID column using a generated sequence (e.g., np.arange) instead of extracting and preserving the original identifier column from the test dataset. This will cause the submission to fail or be evaluated incorrectly if the test dataset has non-sequential or specific IDs.

summary: The agent implements a solid deep learning pipeline with extensive domain-informed feature engineering and robust data preprocessing (properly fitting scalers and imputers exclusively on the training split). However, it critically fails to preserve the original test IDs, hardcoding them with an arbitrary sequence which will invalidate the submission. Additionally, it evaluates the stochastic model only once and relies entirely on a single metric.
